coverage: Complete damage-group caller and name/substring constructors, nine canonical pointer-vector body reuses, one matching row length-error body, and the complete empty-fill/end-resize invocation reached by the caller.

unowned_exception_tail.reason: Ghidra catch body ends at713173; the decoded rethrow tail has no function owner. The formal tail-repair tool requires a terminal RET and refuses this noreturn CALL tail. No function was recreated or fabricated.

boundaries: Complete 713380 caller with actual source storage and CRT domains. Full upstream resource loading and gameplay admission are unproved.

713270/712FF0/712B80 source covers exactly the empty by-value fill and end resize used by 713380, including shrink. Nonempty fills, arbitrary insertion/erasure positions and allocator-driven structural mutation are not supplied.
35 retained original body copies and 141 declared relocations form the oracle. Seven body references are reused from the immutable AH proof.
Original body count is not an execution count: zero-length template paths and unreachable exception blocks exist. Guards at unimplemented template assignment/exception entries were never reached.

Both sides use actual reconstructed SBO substring assignment and source CRT allocation, free, memmove_s, invalid-handler and atol boundaries. Original static-CRT locale/overflow state, FH3, faults and private native stack aliases are unproved.
New rows preserve their untouched opaque DWORD; only constructed pointer fields and memberships are compared, not allocator-history bytes.
Source negative-number length-error transport is checked separately; original native exceptional execution is not claimed.
